steps: Pour olive oil into a hot pan.
Add the chopped tomatoes and spring onions, then fry.
Add the cooked prawns and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
Cook through, then set the prawn mixture aside.
Add olive oil to the frying pan and pour in the lightly whisked eggs.
Spoon the spicy prawn mixture over the eggs.
Crumble the feta cheese over the top.
Grill for a couple of minutes, until finished.
